notes.title: Patch 1.6 & VOTE FOR US at #FirstImpression event
notes.notes:
We’re happy to announce that we’re taking part in the #FirstImpression event by StakSense!  
In this event, gamers create tier lists of proposed game trailers—and by doing so, also enter a contest for some sweet rewards (like free games 👀).  

Give our trailer some love and help shape its place in the rankings!  

[hr][/hr]  
Patch Notes

The concept of attacks having a fixed number of strikes, modified by certain signets and cards, has been removed. It didn't bring enough to the table for the added complexity it introduced.
For example, we didn’t like how fighting 3 enemies with only 2 strikes per attack forced a 2-turns battle, even when your power far exceeded their combined HPs.
From now on, any overkill damage (power) will be used to strike another target, and so on. This way, scoring a power value higher than the combined HPs of the enemy team will lead to winning the battle on the first turn.
  
* Reworked Cards  
  
* Ammonite's Avarice: Adds gold after every battle. Reduces hand size by 1.  
* Puzzle of Steel: If you have full HP, x3 Ni.  
* Tiger Fang: x1.5 Ni.
  
* Reworked Editions  
  
* Windborn Edition: x1.5 Ni.

* Reworked Signets  
  
* Painted Signet: Tile Vases only have transform options.  
  
* Adjusted Cards  
  
* Spare Talon: Increases the Tak value of each triggered tile by 4 (was 2).  
* Scavenger: Gain 20 Tak for every rune sold during the run (was 10).  
  
Other Changes  
  
* Fixed a bunch of pesky UI bugs (thanks for reaching out and reporting these 💛).  
* We’re pushing toward an Early Access release SOON™. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Card Unlocks Update & Looking Ahead
notes.notes:
This update is a mix of demo content and progress on the game's full version. Take a peek at what's coming in the full release—or find out why it's worth revisiting the demo.
Card Unlocks (part of the demo)
Some familiar cards are now part of a new unlock system — giving seasoned players something fresh to chase, and newcomers a smoother learning curve. Each locked card has its own unique requirement, turning unlocking them into a game of its own. Head to the Collections menu to track your progress and see what it takes to unlock them all.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/e2dd34061c1d863ecdab21508762d66b0fcd12eb.png
New Yellow Runes (part of the demo)

 Savagery: Sets the selected Support die face to a random symbol face from its die type (if any).
New Sphinx Runes (part of the demo)

 Perch: Makes a random card Windborn, destroys all other cards.
 Magnificence: Sets the selected Support die face to the highest numeric face among your dice.
 Reactivity: When the die rolls on this face, trigger it.
 Ascension: All your Attacks and Abilities gain 1 level.
 Pandemonium: Applies Random Roll to all faces of the selected Support die.
 Recast: Select 2 dice, the left die becomes a copy of the right die, -5 Max HP.
New Character: Yohlon (not part of the demo)
We're done implementing Yohlon, the Turtle Clan's master ranger, a hardened scout who thrives in exploring the ever-shifting desert.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/8b43c96558b2398ce58c464822d0b2a718f40e17.png
Yohlon won't be part of the demo, but here's a look at his attacks and skills.
 Quick Shot: Strikes 2 random enemies.  
 Barrage: Strikes 2 random enemies (Level up: Strikes 1 more enemy every 2 levels).
 Opening Shot: Strikes 2 random enemies. On the first turn, grants double Tak and Ni.  
 Poisonous Arrow: Strikes 2 random enemies. If available, consumes all Rerolls and applies Poison stacks equal to Power with the first strike.
 Speed Runner: +10 Tak for each visited scenario.
 Dodge: Gain 1 stack of Dodge, set this face to Smooth Landing.
 Smooth Landing: Set this face to Dodge.
 Snake's Pact: If available, consumes 1 Reroll and applies Snake's Shedding to the Support die on the left.
 Dice Dance: Triggers a random Support die.
 Ranger Bounty: Applies n (level) stacks of Ranger Bounty to a random enemy.  
 Aim: Applies Aimed to the target enemy. Unlockable Content and a Peek Behind the Curtain
 Aimed: Your attacks will prioritize this target for this turn.
 Wanderer's Quiver Mastery: Find Canyons, Caverns, Ruins more often.
 Pathfinding: Shadow King: When set, the next scenarios will include a Shadow King.
 Finders Keepers: If in Desert: +10 Tak. If in Canyons: add 4 gold. If in Caverns: add a random yellow rune.
 Pathfinding: Lost Sphinx Vase: When set, the next scenarios will include a Lost Sphinx Vase.
 Pathfinding: Lost Signet: When set, the next scenarios will include a Lost Signet.  
New Biome: Caverns (not part of the demo)
We have been working on a new biome, the caverns. Like the canyons, it's a 3-battles-in-a-row area with a special reward on completion. As expected, it has its own mobs and bosses! This will not be included in the demo for the foreseeable future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/3ce692dd3a510e5e2865ab9bdcca1ac7843fea0a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/c5fed3af75cf9634870ec050d6267c768d05a666.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/d678bd3ada8d75936054bca613a245bb6168fffc.png
Miscellaneous Changes

 Enemies that inflict bleeding or poison on attack will now display so next to their damage intent.
 Cards and dice that were previously emitting a "!" on trigger now emit the specific amount of Tak or Ni they provide.
 The order of triggering of dice in some complex cases has been adjusted.
 As usual, some work has gone into better balancing cards and ice.

notes.title: The Kagu update
notes.notes:
News
We're excited to bring you a new character, new content, and card editions that add some side effects to cards.
New Character
Kagu is the venerable shaman of the Crab Clan, he who yells at clouds for thunderous effects. Kagu has a single attack, Thunder, which acts as an axis around which his other abilities are built around. Be it increasing the number of thunder strikes, or mantras that permanently use up an ability slot to set an edition to a random card.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/a57bf75441c7c9442bc539ce8b17b434a9f08a65.png
Card Editions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/1905eeb70210830e38a52b78cb3f980bf11dde30.png
A card edition adds an extra effect to a card. Any character can find cards with editions at the merchant or in vases, and any card can have an edition.

 Ethereal: Doesn't occupy a card slot.
 Earthen: +1 Armor each turn.
 Sunborn: +3 gold on battle end.
 Windborn: Attacks strike one additional time.
 Veiled: On battle start, the next Prayer costs 2 less.
 Ni Infused: +5 Ni.
 Tak Infused: +25 Tak.
 Serpentine: Adds a free reroll to merchants.
New Cards:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/2cb575d116d72959f2d524a220e0d73cb853b83e.png

 Return to Nature: Gains x Ni when rerolling a symbol face, resets to 1 on battle end (Currently: x).
 Mounting Frenzy: n in m chance of gaining x Ni at the end of the battle (Currently: x).
 Laughing Relics: Gains x Ni when discarding an Uncommon or Rare card (Currently: x).
 Golden Zenith: Earn 3 gold whenever the highest numeric face is triggered (HighestNumericFace).
 Rank Climber: At the end of the battle, earn gold equal to the highest level of any symbol face among your dice (HighestLevelSymbolFace).
 Dark Ritual: When discarded, removes 1 stacks from Djinn's Favor.
New Prayers

 Ummia: Your Mastery gains 1 level.
 Conjure Card: Adds a random Uncommon card (must have room).
New Dice/Die Faces:

 Die of the Queen, Queen's Touch: On trigger, disable this die until the end of the battle and level up the symbol face to the right.


Have feedback or suggestions? Share them in the Steam forum—we're checking regularly!

notes.title: The Cards and Runes Update
notes.notes:
Skills have become cards
Their availability during combat follows the classic card battler formula, with a deck and a discard pile. This comes after reflecting on all the feedback we got, from the original combat-only alpha up to now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/6292687d63870765bb4ac491a551c58440340b72.png

Yet another slay the spire clone you say? Stop right there! Here's the real deal of this post: runes! Runes allow you to power up skills during combat, enabling you to create powerful effects and execute crazy combos.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/674bce08fc3a46f98ea8190217fa467d332cfe76.png
Let's take one step back and break down what a card looks like:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/fc789071c48c24a7e77960bae457a50c55d875bd.png

The top left area contains the card cost, its icon, name, and, just below the name, its tags, like "Attack" or "Skill". Certain runes require a card to have a specific tag to be applied. Below that, are the rune sockets, which show what runes are already applied and what capacity the card has.

At the center of the card is the combo: this effect is applied only if (at least) a certain amount of rune colors have been applied. Finally, at the bottom is the base effect of the card, e.g. doing some damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/b3680681ce3b58c0dd9c242b1a04451e5f848a57.gif

Runes follow a logic similar to cards: you start the game with a deck of runes and discard or acquire new runes by visiting points of interest or as a reward for battles.

New battle UI
The battle UI went through a comprehensive rework to accommodate cards and runes. Moreover, characters aren't in a line anymore but are distributed across the battlefield for a more natural look.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/a56e9e53ef6b53ede9cd99f2339cffbd24423bc4.png

Runes and Prayers

Most prayers of the prayer system (link) have been realigned to (also) provide runes at the cost of some water, this will help in getting out of tricky situations when, if only you had that one rune, things would work out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/6612ba50ae471504983b492bd63b94734ae24f34.png

Dialogs

Runes and prayers also tie in with dialogs. We wanted to get away from the (in our humble opinion)
stale "classic" formula for dialogs, and runes fit the purpose perfectly.

Dialog choices will now include rune sockets that can represent a requirement or a power-up, that is, fitting the right runes would increase the probability of a good outcome or its magnitude. Short of a rune? Perhaps a prayer can help.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/e99b98a14fb95c60a4964a90b8e3868bb244295a.png
The camping location has been reworked into a special dialog where the available activities depend on which characters are in the party! ⛺⛺⛺

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792429/62da4456f4350e8927a0e465ea9b4210ce6a1e79.png

What excites us the most about runes is the opportunity to plug in rare and tricky runes into the game, daily runs will be an excellent place for this.
We also hope that modders will enjoy the experience of creating new runes, something that we're making as simple as possible.
